items.title: [Bug]: validate --json and deliver --json emit plain-text argument errors
items.body:
### Archify version or commit

c6519401f7b91b9d43011657880893b0a8955548

### Installation method

Git clone

### Diagram type

Workflow

### Exact command

```shell
node bin/archify.mjs validate workflow examples/agent-tool-call.workflow.json --quality hero --json
node bin/archify.mjs deliver workflow examples/agent-tool-call.workflow.json --bogus --json
```

### Minimal redacted JSON reproduction

```json
{}
```

### Validation receipt or exact error

```json
Both commands exit 2 with empty stdout.

validate stderr:
Unknown quality profile "hero". Expected standard or showcase.

deliver stderr:
Unknown deliver option "--bogus".
```

### Expected behavior

Each command should exit 2, write exactly one machine-readable JSON failure receipt to stdout, leave stderr empty, use `stage: "arguments"`, and include a stable diagnostic code.

### Actual behavior

Both commands emit plain-text argument errors to stderr and write nothing to stdout. This violates the documented `--json` contract for `validate` and `deliver`, which promises a single JSON document even on failure.

### Supporting visual evidence

_No response_

### Environment

Windows 11; Node.js 24.19.0. Also reproducible with Node.js 18, 20, and 22. Installation: Git clone.

### Final checks

- [x] I searched existing issues for the same problem.
- [x] I removed access tokens, credentials, private repository contents, and personal or customer data.
